notes:
{付|つ}き{合|あ}う covers various types of relationships and social interactions.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)

THREE MAIN MEANINGS:
1. To associate/socialize: ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}う (to socialize with neighbors)
2. To date: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧/⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}う (to date him/her)
3. To accompany: ⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}う (to accompany shopping)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}う: to date/associate with ~
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}う: to accompany someone to ~
- ⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧: relationship, association (noun form)
- ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧: a long relationship

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {付|つ}き{合|あ}っている: are dating
- ⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧⟦{始|はじ}める→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧: to start dating
- ⟦{上手|うま}く→上手：00707_jouzu⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}う: to get along well with

ASPECT (ている):
- {付|つ}き{合|あ}っている: is dating / is associating with (continuous/habitual state)
- Note: For sense 2 (dating), {付|つ}き{合|あ}っている describes the ongoing state of being in a relationship, not the process of starting one. For sense 1, ⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧{付|つ}き{合|あ}っている means "have had a long association." The plain form {付|つ}き{合|あ}う is used for dictionary or hypothetical statements; for the actual current state of knowing/dating someone, use the ている form. To describe starting a relationship, use ⟦{付|つ}き{合|あ}い→付き合い：03520_tsukiai⟧⟦{始|はじ}める→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧.
